title: Tamsin and the Harvest
author: Ulyana Whitlock
blurb: Rosalind Eriksen, an urban explorer mapping tunnels that aren't on any survey, has spent seven years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
